name: Call of the Wild

components.m: a bit of animal fur or hide

sustain.label: Call of the Wild: command
sustain.help: A Magic action on a later turn: a new command to the Beasts that failed the save; each follows it on its next turn (without one it waits). Those that passed are only Charmed until your next turn starts.

summary: 100-ft Emanation, Concentration: each Beast makes a Wis save; failures are Charmed and obey you (a Magic action re-orders), successes are Charmed only until your next turn.
text: You unleash a primal howl that calls lesser creatures to your command. Each Beast in a 100-foot Emanation from you when you cast the spell makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure the Beast has the Charmed condition, understands your commands and follows them on its next turn to the best of its ability; on each of your later turns you can take a Magic action to give a new command. On a success the Beast is Charmed only until the start of your next turn, and you cannot command it. The howl can be heard within 300 feet. Concentration, up to 1 minute.
